name: Venomancer: Weaver Form keeps Protraction's Spore and Wilt durations and only hastes ticks (#7591)
contract: #7591: with Protraction rank 2 (707871, SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER misc 1 SPELLMOD_DURATION +6000) Spore 804983 (duration index 86, 21 s) lasts 27 s and Wilt 804982 (index 85, 18 s) lasts 24 s, but in Weaver Form 804980 they showed 21/18 s with haste. Weaver Form keeps helper 804981 up (AscensionVenomancer SetHelper), whose effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HASTE (316) with family 35 mask (8256, 520, 67174784) covering every Spore and Wilt rank. WotLK aura 316 multiplies both the aura duration (Spell.cpp aura apply, Aura::RefreshDuration/RefreshTimersWithMods) and the period (AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic) by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED. Maintainer decision: Weaver Form must not cut the duration; haste only shortens the tick interval, so the DoT gets more ticks (GetTotalTicks = max duration / amplitude). Unit::HasDurationShorteningPeriodicHaste ignores 804981 at the duration sites only; other aura 316 sources keep WotLK semantics. Icy Veins 12472 (+20% casting speed) is the haste fixture: the expected duration stays 27000/24000 ms while the 3000 ms period becomes about 2500 ms. Before the fix the durations were 27000 x 0.833 = 22500 and 24000 x 0.833 = 20000 ms.
